results.title: Chat with Work - AI Tool For Workflows
results.content:
AI bots hosted in Europe. You decide.

AI bots that do your team's chores. You just decide.

Overview

## Overview

Chat with Work gives your team AI bots that do the chores between your tools, hosted in Europe on every plan.

A bot starts at a time you set or when something happens: a new lead, a support ticket, a GitHub release, an email. It does the work across your connected apps, and anything that needs you waits in one queue, Decisions, where you approve, edit or decline on the web or on your phone. Nothing changes in your tools without your approval, unless you let a bot run by itself. [...] Models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and Mistral run in the EU, and the app is hosted in Germany. You can also run it on your own servers, with local models if you like. Start with a one-time free trial of 300 credits.

Bots and chats work across about 1,900 integrations: mail, calendars, CRMs, helpdesks, files, billing, issue trackers and team chat, plus your own MCP servers. You can also just chat: ask one question across all of them, and share the chat with your team in a project.

Bots answer in Slack, Microsoft Teams, Discord and Campfire. The desktop app for Mac, Windows and Linux lets them work with folders, files, commands, a scanner, a printer and your browser, as you allow. The iPhone and Android apps keep the queue in your pocket.
